subject: Superintendent Performance Evaluation and Goal Setting
overview: The committee met to permit the correction of errors in a member's performance evaluation of the superintendent and to reschedule the timeline for establishing the superintendent's upcoming goals.

items.title: Superintendent Evaluation Correction
items.summary: Approved the resubmission of Member McLaughlin's evaluation of the superintendent after rescinding the previous approval to correct technical errors in the submission form.

items.title: Superintendent Goals Timeline
items.summary: Approved a revised schedule for setting the superintendent's 2022-2023 goals, with the initial discussion moved to early September and a finalization deadline of September 30.
